name: Ananya Sharma
title: Principal Security Engineer
summary: A seasoned Principal Security Engineer with over 10 years of experience in designing, implementing, and managing robust security architectures. Proven ability to lead complex security initiatives, mitigate advanced threats, and ensure compliance across multi-cloud and on-premise environments. Expertise in incident response, security operations, and driving DevSecOps practices.

bullets: Led the architectural design and implementation of cloud security frameworks across AWS and Azure, reducing critical vulnerabilities by 30%.
Developed and operationalized a new incident response playbook, decreasing average incident resolution time by 20% and improving post-incident analysis.
Mentored a team of 5 security engineers, enhancing their capabilities in threat hunting, security tool optimization, and secure development practices.
Championed DevSecOps initiatives, integrating security as code and automated vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines, improving security posture pre-production.
Managed and optimized SIEM infrastructure (Splunk), improving log ingestion and analysis efficiency by 25% for faster threat detection and correlation.
Implemented automated security scanning tools (SAST/DAST) in CI/CD pipelines, identifying and remediating over 150 security defects before production deployment.
Conducted regular penetration testing and vulnerability assessments for critical applications, leading to the closure of over 50 high-severity findings.
Developed and enforced security policies and standards across various platforms, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and best practices.
Monitored and responded to security alerts and incidents using various security tools including IDS/IPS, WAF, and endpoint protection.
Assisted in the development and enforcement of internal security policies and procedures, achieving 100% compliance in internal security audits.
Provided security awareness training to over 200 employees annually, significantly reducing the organization's susceptibility to phishing and social engineering attacks.
Participated in forensic investigations and analysis of security breaches, contributing to root cause identification and remediation strategies.

education.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
